args.subject: Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail — great weekend hike
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend Cascade Falls Trail in the national park — it's perfect for weekend hikes. The trail is about 3 miles round trip and offers beautiful waterfall views. Great short outing for fresh air and scenery.

If you'd like, I can send directions or help pick a day to go.

Thanks,

args.subject: Recommendation: Alex — Personal Trainer at Main Street Gym
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Alex — they're a wonderful personal trainer at the gym on Main Street. Alex is great at creating customized workout plans tailored to individual goals and needs. If you're looking for a trainer, I think you'd really enjoy working with them.

Best regards,

args.subject: Recommendation: Sarah — Piano Teacher (Classical, 15+ years)
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Sarah as a piano teacher. She's a fantastic instructor who specializes in classical music and has been teaching for over 15 years. She’s patient, knowledgeable, and great at tailoring lessons to each student’s level and goals — excellent if you or someone you know is interested in building strong technique and repertoire in classical piano.

If you'd like, I can send Sarah’s contact details or introduce you directly.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: FitTrack fitness app
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend FitTrack — it’s a great new fitness app I’ve been using. It’s really helpful for tracking workouts (sets, reps, cardio, GPS routes) and includes strong meal-planning features to help you stay on target with nutrition. The interface is easy to use and it syncs well with most wearables.

If you’d like, I can share the app link or help you get started with it.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery downtown
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown. Their sourdough bread is incredible — they bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM. If you go early you'll get a fresh loaf; they also have great pastries and coffee. Highly recommend stopping by!

Let me know if you'd like the address or their hours.

Thanks,
